title: How to Make Money on TikTok Shop: 3 Proven Paths for Sellers, Creators, and Brands
summary: Compare TikTok Shop revenue paths for sellers and affiliate creators, plus separate TikTok creator programs, eligibility, costs, and operating risks.
body_markdown:
## Path 2: earn commission as an affiliate creator


An approved affiliate creator can select eligible products and make shoppable videos or LIVE content. When an eligible order is attributed under the platform's current rules, the creator may receive the displayed commission after applicable validation. Returns, cancellations, enforcement, attribution, and program terms can change the final amount.


### Check the creator type and account status


TikTok Shop distinguishes independent affiliate creators from creators formally bound to a seller as marketing or official accounts. The current US[Creator Eligibility Policy](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?identity=1&knowledge_id=6939143037667118&lang=en) explains these account types, identity and age checks, marketplace access, pilot programs, and compliance. Do not assume the US requirements apply elsewhere or that every account with a certain follower count is eligible.


### Select products you can represent accurately


Review the listing, seller, customer feedback, delivery promise, commission shown in the account, and any sample terms. Choose products relevant to your audience and content style. Do not claim personal results you did not experience or repeat health, performance, or comparison claims without approved evidence.


### Measure content, not income promises


Track products requested, samples received, assets published, views, product clicks where available, attributed orders, cancellations, returns, and validated commission. Compare formats and product fit over a meaningful window. Revenue varies by eligibility, audience, content quality, availability, attribution, and customer behavior.
